name: spara-aegis
description: Spara Aegis gives each staff member the QuickBooks companies and client files assigned to their own Microsoft account.

interface.longDescription: Spara Aegis connects ChatGPT to the QuickBooks companies and client files assigned to the signed-in Spara staff member. List those clients first, then select one before reading reports, records, or notes. QuickBooks stays read-only unless an administrator enables writes for that client. A write is proposed with its full details, approved separately, and executed only after another explicit confirmation. The connector cannot see clients that are not assigned to the signed-in person.
defaultPrompt: List the clients assigned to me.
Show this month's profit and loss for the client I select.
Post the bank statement I attach after I confirm the client and account.
